title: Share Withheld on a Car Rental Given Up, by Notice Ahead of Collection
content:
The share withheld when a rental on the Car Rental Rate Classes is given up is decided by how many whole days lie between the day the rental is given up and the scheduled collection day.

**The notice schedule.**

| Whole days between the day the rental is given up and the scheduled collection day | Share withheld |
|---|---|
| 14 or more | 25 percent |
| 3 to 13 | 50 percent |
| Fewer than 3 | 100 percent |

The share is applied once to the money it acts on.

**Both sides of each threshold.** At exactly 14 whole days the share is 25 percent, the band opening at that figure; at 13 whole days it is 50 percent. At exactly 3 whole days the share is 50 percent; at 2 whole days it is 100 percent. A rental given up on the scheduled collection day itself stands at 0 whole days and carries the share of 100 percent.

**Illustration on hypothetical notice.** A rental scheduled to collect on a given day and given up 20 whole days beforehand carries a share of 25 percent. Given up 5 whole days beforehand, it carries 50 percent. Given up 1 whole day beforehand, it carries 100 percent.
